title: A gated NPC check (the ash-boy's will check to slip past the palace gate) had no visible alternate solution hinted at when it kept failing; the actual solution (Lord Marshal's escort token) was only discoverable by wandering to an unrelated location.
where: Marrowgate — The Servants' Way / Palace Gate
